[center][u][b][size=5]Animated Well[/size][/b][/u]

[size=2]This mod will replace the vanilla well with an animated well. You can change which type you want. Check out the config file to disable/enable animations or change type.[/size][/center][font=Arial][b][center]﻿------------------[/center][/b][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][b][u][/u][size=4][u]Installation[/u][/size][/b][/font]
[font=Arial][size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
[b] - [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[b] - [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[b] - [/b]and[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] (if you want to see the animation[/size][b][size=3])[/size][size=2]﻿[/size][/b][/font][*][left][size=3]Unzip or extract the files and drop it into your Stardew Valley mods folder, then load up the game. Enjoy.[/size][/left]
[*][left][size=3]Run the game once to create the [i]config.json[/i] file in the mod folder, where you can enable or disable the animation[/size][size=3] by simply change to "true" or "false". [/size][/left]
[/list]
[left][list]
[*][b][u][size=3]Note[/size][/u][/b]
[/list][/left] ﻿- [size=2]The second well of this mod  is based on a well from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196]Lumisteria Building[/url].[/size]
